newsitem.title: SPAIN: Quoted Spanish firms' profits rose 6.4 pct to Sept.
newsitem.headline: Quoted Spanish firms' profits rose 6.4 pct to Sept.

text.p: Quoted Spanish firms saw a 6.4 percent increase in gross profit to 1.72 trillion pesetas in the nine months to September, a stock exchange commision CNMV report said on Wednesday.
The CNMV report, which included 350 listed companies, found that average personnel had fallen 0.09 percent from the same period a year earlier.
The financial and insurance sector increased gross profit by 15.39 percent to 618.80 billion pesetas.
Banks' profits rose 14.14 percent to 586.34 billion pesetas.

Energy companies increased profits by 7.58 percent to 600.0 billion pesetas, although oil companies alone saw their profits fall back 8.6 percent. Electricity companies alone saw a 13.03 percent increase in profit in the first nine months of the year.
The transport and communications sector saw profits rise 20.2 percent to 265.98 bilion pesetas.
